remaining_blockers.description: PR #46 is still draft; owner/review path and explicit merge readiness are not recorded here.
Independent product QA evidence remains required: desktop/mobile screenshots, console/network pass, PWA install/offline shell, and deployed app proof.
server-kfrm still needs fresh heartbeat, completed read-only probe, and node-local artifact evidence before heavy remote runs.
T-Bank sandbox end-to-end evidence is still required: checkout, signed notification, recurring charge, RebillId, admin token, and fiscalization decision.
Telegram reports still need a live safe delivery smoke through the gateway with owner chat id and no secret/internal path leakage.
Deterministic estimates still need the P0 API, manifest, validation, publish, revision, and benchmark contract closed beyond the golden local test.
